# exactl completion

A completion script lets your shell complete exactl commands and options with the Tab key. Each shell has its own script.

Source the script in your shell profile, for example `source <(exactl completion bash)` in `~/.bashrc`.

## exactl completion bash

Print the bash completion script

Prints the bash completion script to stdout. It changes nothing on its own: source it from your shell profile.

**Usage:** `exactl completion bash [options]`

**Options**

- `-n, --name <command-name>`: The name of the main command. (type: string)

**Examples**

Print the bash script:

```bash
exactl completion bash
```

**Output:** protocol.

**Exit codes**

- FAILURE (1)

**See also:** [exactl completion fish](completion.md#exactl-completion-fish), [exactl completion zsh](completion.md#exactl-completion-zsh)
